scraper.name: Scraper
scraper.goal: Read the LinkedIn profile and save it as structured JSON, without filling any gaps.
scraper.description: Drives Claude in Chrome in a fresh tab, expands every section, extracts headline, About, experience, skills and posts, and records what it could not see so downstream agents never guess.

recruiter.name: Recruiter
recruiter.goal: Find what to change in the next 1–12 months to get more and better interviews.
recruiter.description: Scores the profile like a senior technical recruiter: skill gaps, keywords, header and About, experience, certifications, salary research, and paste-ready profile changes. Cites every market claim.

career-coach.name: Career Coach
career-coach.goal: Set the 2–3 year direction: industry, target role, country and track.
career-coach.description: Builds a long-horizon strategy grounded in the WEF Future of Jobs report and BLS data: compares countries, company sizes and IC versus management, with a SWOT and a skip-for-now list. Never touches LinkedIn copy.
career-coach.inputs: profile JSON, WEF and BLS pages

synthesis.name: Synthesis
synthesis.goal: Merge both reviews into one run document the web app can render.
synthesis.description: Combines recruiter and coach output into the schema v2 run: summary, snapshot, plan and what changed since the last run. It only merges; it never scrapes, re-runs agents or invents findings.

orchestrator.name: Orchestrator
orchestrator.goal: Run the whole pipeline from one command and publish the result.
orchestrator.description: The main Claude Code session behind /linkedin-review: starts the run, launches each subagent (recruiter and coach in parallel), checks their output, validates the run, publishes it and reports back.
